verdict.rationale: Obsidian documents a first-party headless Sync client that syncs vaults without the desktop app and is explicitly positioned for CI pipelines, agents, and automated workflows. That headless mode is scoped to syncing only, though; nothing in the evidence shows the app's features (plugins, Bases, templates, URI actions) running headlessly. Missing for 10: headless execution of core app functionality beyond sync, CLI/setup documentation depth, independent or hands-on corroboration of CI use.
